correctness.rationale: Exact L_F=M-11^T decomposition and Sherman-Morrison give formula (1). Same-part costs differ by (N-4)(v-u)/(2(N-u)(N-v)). Cross-part pairs have strictly larger trace than putting both in the smaller part: their rational difference is explicitly a sum of five nonnegative-coefficient polynomials with strictly positive P0 divided by a positive denominator. All hypotheses ensure positive definiteness and boundary validity. Independent exact-rational direct grounded matrix checks: 49 graph configurations/3322 pairs; identity grid 729 points. The mathematical proof is the algebra, not the finite samples.

value.rationale: The exact all-configurations and optimizer-count law for heterogeneous complete multipartite consensus networks is motivated by choosing two costly noise-free observation/control sites. The solution contradicts naive geographic spread between dense communities: all optimum pairs are nonadjacent co-part vertices from a smallest part, even as the other part sizes vary independently. It supplies a sharp structural selection rule and an exact objective, not only a numerical scan.
